title: History Of Planning In India
definition: The systematic and directed mobilization of national resources by the state to achieve targeted socio-economic growth, evolving from pre-independence nationalist blueprints to centralized Five-Year Plans and modern cooperative federalism.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for GS Paper III (Indian Economy, Planning, Resource Mobilization, Growth & Development) and Prelims regarding institutional evolution, plan objectives, structural shifts, and the transition from Planning Commission to NITI Aayog.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of History Of Planning In India.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
